description: Upload HTML or code and get a public share URL plus an edit token. Each call creates a new asset (no overwrite); content is public unless password-protected and auto-expires after expiresIn (default 7d, 0 = permanent). Anonymous uploads are rate-limited to 10 per hour per IP. Use view to read an asset back, list_assets to see your own files, or delete to remove one.

filename.description: Optional display filename used in the title and download name.

language.description: Content language hint, e.g. html, css, js, json, markdown. Default html.

password.description: Optional password; the web view asks for it before showing content.

name: upload
